description: Push-through cut built on TransitionBoilerplate: outgoing scene recedes/rotates away, incoming scene continues the same spin/depth, both pivoting around a carried asset's position (or frame center as fallback). Reads as the camera pushing through a shared element rather than a plain cut.

carryAssetId.description: asset id present in both outgoing and incoming scene to pivot the push/spin around; omit to pivot around frame center

intensity.description: scales distance/recede-amount/spin/blur together, 0 = nearly a plain fade, ~2 = aggressive

spinDeg.description: degrees of continuous rotation across the cut
